identity.title: ALMA Observations of Layered Structures due to CO Selective Dissociation in the ρ Ophiuchi A Plane-parallel PDR

analysis_steps.goal: Identify CO layered structure in channel maps

method.value: Inspect channel maps of 12CO, 13CO, C18O at 2.2–2.6 km/s relative to S1 and the 1.3 mm continuum

method.value: Tex from peak 12CO brightness temperature; tau13, tau18 from that Tex; N under LTE via Nishimura15 eq. 11

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Clumpy PDR disfavoured since layering is hard to form with inhomogeneous density

evidence.quote: It is difficult to form such layered structures in a clumpy PDR

limitations_admitted.value: Near systemic velocity emission attenuated/resolved out; observed R13/18 is a lower limit; LTE assumed

evidence.quote: the observed $R_{13/18}$ should be treated as the lower limit to the actual $R_{13/18}$.

Spatial filtering and absorption near the systemic velocity bias ratios
